notes.subject: gutpela hap tru
notes.rationale: מחלב em i 'gris / hap swit tru' — hap i swait moa long olgeta, i no 'finest' nating

notes.subject: satisfied thee
notes.rationale: גרש 'him/them' (יוכילהו) tasol רב 'thee' (אשביעך) — tupela man i klostu: em i givim ol man kaikai, tasol em i tok long yu

notes.subject: hani bilong bikpela ston
notes.rationale: hani i kamap long ston — tok bilong givim gutpela samting i no isi

translation: Na em i givim ⟨em⟩ kaikai long gutpela hap tru bilong witi, na wantaim hani bilong bikpela ston mi pulapim ⟨yu⟩.
